experiment.name: piere_perception_sensitivity_expanded
experiment.title: Sensitivity to queue-count errors across demand regimes
experiment.description: Five demand regimes, four reproducible observation-error levels, and 30 seeds. Only controller observations are perturbed; the generated arrival streams and physical queues remain unchanged across error levels for each regime and seed.
